messages:
sam: Quick PSA — final cut for 1.9.0 is today at 17:00 UTC. Please get your version bump PRs and one-line release notes in before cutoff. Template and examples are here: https://repo.redwood.dev/docs/release_notes_template.md. Note: changelog-lint will block merges.

maya: I'll own the release merge. Ping me if you need a quick format check.

chris: On release/1.9 branch — preparing to merge the version bump PR #422. Can someone eyeball my changelog entry shape? Locally the lint failed with: `changelog-lint: malformed entry, missing component tag`

alex: Example shape we use: `- [runtime] Improve KV cache pruning to reduce mem usage. (chris)` — component in square brackets, short imperative sentence, and author in parens. Template has more examples.

jen: Quick note: if this needs a backport to 1.8.x, we need the patch PR + separate changelog entry on the release-1.8 branch. Backport cutoff is 15:00 UTC today.

ci-bot: ci-bot: changelog-lint failed on PR #422 — see checks in CI.

chris: Thanks, fixing now. One question: should small internal API tweaks be labeled `breaking`? It's not customer visible but might affect integrations.

maya: Only mark `breaking` if we changed a public contract or removed a supported flag. Otherwise use `behavior` or `fix`. Keep `breaking` for real user-impact changes.

sam: Action items: chris update the PR with the square-bracket component tag and one-liner; jen coordinate any necessary backports; maya will merge at 17:05 UTC if CI is green. If lint still complains, paste the failing message here and someone will help. :thumbsup:

alex: Left a tiny nit in the PR about present-tense verb forms in one-liners. Also, when in doubt follow the template's sample entry that uses bullets under the component heading.

chris: Updated PR and changelog snippet: 
```
- [runtime] Improve KV cache pruning to reduce mem usage. (chris)
```
Ran the linter locally — passes now.

ci-bot: ci-bot: All checks passed on PR #422 — changelog-lint OK.

maya: Merging at 17:05 UTC. After merge I'll trigger the v1.9.0 bump and publish release notes. If anything else lands between now and cutoff, flag it here immediately.

sam: Thanks all — tagging @release-ops for post-release archival and CHANGELOG aggregation.
